title: Finite global dimension gives finite projective dimension of the residue field
statement: Let R be a local ring of finite global dimension. Then its residue field has finite projective dimension.

proof.text: Apply the uniform projective resolution bound in the definition of finite global dimension to the residue field module.

lean.statement: theorem residueField_hasFiniteProjectiveDimension (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (h : Ring.HasFiniteGlobalDimension.{u, max u v} R) : ModuleCat.HasFiniteProjectiveDimension (ModuleCat.of R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
